name: Duo Security
description: Duo provides two-factor authentication, endpoint remediation, and secure single sign-on tools. The Sumo Logic App for Duo Security helps you monitor your Duo account's authentication logs, administrator logs, and telephony logs. The dashboards provide insight into failed and successful authentications, events breakdown by applications, factors, users,  geo-location of events, admin activities, outliers, threat analysis of authentication and administrator events.

children.name: Duo Security - Administrator Events
children.description: See geo - location of admin events, one day time comparison of events,  login errors, admin activity over time, and events breakdown by action

panels.name: Geo Location of Failed Admin Logins
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/duo administrator  "admin_login_error"
| json field=_raw "eventtype" as eventtype   
| where eventtype = "administrator" 
| json field=_raw "action" as action 
| where action = "admin_login_error"
| json field=_raw "object" as object 
| json field=_raw "timestamp" as time
| time* 1000 as timemilli
| formatDate(fromMillis(toLong(timemilli)), "MM-dd-yyyy HH:mm:ss") as date_time
| json field=_raw "username" as user_name
| json field=_raw "description" as description
| json field=description "error"
| json field=description "email"
| json field=description "ip_address"
| lookup latitude, longitude, country_code, country_name, region, city, postal_code from geo://location on ip = ip_address
| count by latitude, longitude, country_code, country_name, region, city, postal_code
| sort _count

| timeslice {{Timeslice}}
| count by _timeslice
| outlier _count window={{Window}},threshold={{Threshold}},consecutive={{Consecutive}},direction=+

queryParameters.name: Consecutive
queryParameters.label: Consecutive
queryParameters.description: Calculates violation if consecutive X data points are observed away from Threshold

queryParameters.name: Threshold
queryParameters.label: Threshold
queryParameters.description: Calculate violation based on +/- X standard deviations. The default is 3.0

queryParameters.name: Window
queryParameters.label: Window
queryParameters.description: The trailing data points defined by Window Number, to calculate mean and sigma. The default is 10

panels.name: Threat Intel Analysis of Admin Events
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/duo administrator  
| json field=_raw "eventtype" as eventtype   
| where eventtype = "administrator" 
| json field=_raw "action" as action 
| json field=_raw "object" as object 
| json field=_raw "timestamp" as time
| time* 1000 as timemilli
| formatDate(fromMillis(toLong(timemilli)), "MM-dd-yyyy HH:mm:ss") as date_time
| json field=_raw "username" as user_name
| json field=_raw "description" as description
| json field=description "ip_address"
| lookup type, actor, raw, threatlevel as malicious_confidence from sumo://threat/cs on threat=ip_address
| where type="ip_address"  and malicious_confidence = "high"
| json field=raw "labels[*].name" as label_name 
| replace(label_name, "\\/","->") as label_name
| replace(label_name, "\""," ") as label_name
| count by date_time, ip_address, action, object, user_name, description, label_name

panels.name: Threat Intel Analysis of Authentication Events
panels.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/duo authentication 
| json field=_raw "eventtype" as eventtype nodrop  
| where eventtype = "authentication"
| json field=_raw "result" as result 
| json field=_raw "access_device.ip" as ip
| json field=_raw "access_device.location.city" as city
| json field=_raw "access_device.location.country" as country
| json field=_raw "access_device.location.state" as state
| json field=_raw "application.name" as application_name
| json field=_raw "factor" as factor
| json field=_raw "reason" as reason
| json field=_raw "result" as result 
| json field=_raw "timestamp" as time
| time* 1000 as timemilli
| formatDate(fromMillis(toLong(timemilli)), "MM-dd-yyyy HH:mm:ss") as date_time
| json field=_raw "user.name" as user_name
| lookup type, actor, raw, threatlevel as malicious_confidence from sumo://threat/cs on threat=ip
| where type="ip_address"  and malicious_confidence = "high"
| json field=raw "labels[*].name" as label_name 
| replace(label_name, "\\/","->") as label_name
| replace(label_name, "\""," ") as label_name
| count by date_time, ip, eventtype, result, city, application_name, factor, reason, user_name, label_name
